$description: GA Console design tokens (W3C DTCG). The source of truth: tokens.css is generated from this file by `python -m ga.console.tokens`. Grammar (rev 2): dark and monochrome -- near-black ground, near-white ink, grays; no chromatic colour; attention by inversion; a line only where it carries function.

bg.$description: near-black ground; the only theme (no light variant)

surface.$description: a raised plane: input wells, the log, bar tracks

sub.$description: captions, secondary text (AA on bg and surface)

line.$description: functional lines only. There is deliberately no token for a decorative line: sections, rows, headers and cards are separated by space and type weight.

track.$description: progress / work-track stop not reached yet, the empty part of a bar; disabled control outline (>= 3:1 on bg)

fill.$description: progress / work-track stop reached, bar fill

control.$description: outline that makes a control look clickable or an input fillable

inverse.$description: attention and failure: a near-white block with near-black text (inversion), plus a shape and words. Inside it the tokens above are swapped for these.

surface.$description: a raised plane inside an inverted block

sub.$description: secondary text on the inverted block

line-track.$description: unreached track inside an inverted block

line-control.$description: control outline inside an inverted block

ok.$description: done / healthy: ink, filled square mark

live.$description: running: ink, ring mark that breathes

wait.$description: waiting / unknown: sub, hollow ring mark

fail.$description: failed / sent back: a cross mark in ink; the item itself is inverted

mast.$description: the masthead / the one protagonist: big type in empty space

breath.$description: one breath of a living thing (running service, live run); never under reduced motion
